items.title: Indiana forest inventory — 2025 evaluation (mortality, growth, volume)
items.summary: Indiana FIA 2025 evaluation: 4.83M acres of forest land, 14.07B cu ft growing-stock volume. Average annual growing-stock mortality 167M cu ft/yr (1.18% of standing volume; SE 5.5%), net growth 313M cu ft/yr (2.23% of volume). Mortality rate was 1.19% in the 2024 evaluation (-0.01 points).

label: USFS Forest Inventory and Analysis — Indiana (EVALIDator)
